title: RewardProviderNode.v1
description: A node in the reward-provider graph: a concrete scorer the spine MAY route a RewardSpec to (deterministic checker, test runner, diff oracle). status moves candidate -> reference -> active under governance; a node is never born active. deterministic flags whether the scorer yields the same RewardResult for the same input+output (preferred — non-deterministic scorers are held back / used only as advisory). serves_truth is always false — a scorer produces a measurement (RewardResult, is_truth=false), never served truth.

provider_id.description: unique id of this reward provider node

status.description: governance status; nodes start as candidate, NEVER active by default

deterministic.description: true when the scorer is reproducible for the same input+output (preferred)

serves_truth.description: ALWAYS false — a reward provider produces a measurement, never served truth
